description: I'm Samuel Bernardes, a Software Engineer, Computer Engineering student at CEFET-MG and Informatics Technician graduate from IFMG. I work on Full Stack development with React and TypeScript on the front-end and Python (FastAPI) and Node.js on the back-end, as well as AWS cloud, Spark data pipelines and PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases. I'm interested in projects involving technological innovation, data and high-quality software development.
